text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Myamyamya?!
This Island Whale is ten times scarier than the other ones!
text_block_list.orig_text:
にゃにゃにゃー！？
この島クジラ、
今までとは段違いのおっかなさにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I think you're right. But we can't afford to retreat!
Let's fully optimize our equipment, and turn the tables on the beast!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうみたいね。
でも、
負けるわけにはいかないわ！
しっかり装備を固めて、
返り討ちにしてやりましょう！
